moved.sentence: Choose the backup method that matches your durability requirements and operational constraints.

judged.note: Choosing the method by durability requirements and operational constraints is kept at SHOULD, and the rule adds the per-method choices.

moved.sentence: Use this when you need progress monitoring or integration into application code.

judged.note: The rule names the Online Backup API for exactly the source's two conditions, progress monitoring or integration into application code, at SHOULD for an unkeyed recommendation.

moved.sentence: Do not use it to synchronize multiple writers.

judged.note: "Do not use it" (it being Litestream) becomes MUST NOT use Litestream to synchronize multiple writers, with the same prohibition and a stronger level.

moved.sentence: Monitor database size so you can detect unexpected growth and decide when to VACUUM.

judged.note: Monitoring database size and both purposes (detect unexpected growth, decide when to VACUUM) are kept at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: Alert when `free_bytes / total_bytes` exceeds 25% — that is a signal to VACUUM.

judged.note: The 25% `free_bytes / total_bytes` alert threshold and its meaning (a signal to VACUUM) are kept at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: Run integrity checks on a schedule or after any suspect event (disk errors, process kills, power loss).

judged.note: Both triggers (on a schedule, after a suspect event) and all three example events are kept at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: Schedule `quick_check` on startup for databases that are critical to the application.

judged.note: `quick_check` on startup, limited to databases critical to the application, is kept at SHOULD.
Reserving `integrity_check` for periodic offline audits is kept at SHOULD with the same limit.

moved.sentence: Define retention windows from the start.

judged.note: Defining retention windows from the start is kept at SHOULD, along with its context (tombstones and outbox entries accumulate without a purge strategy).

moved.sentence: Only purge tombstones after confirming all sync targets have consumed them.

judged.note: "Only purge tombstones after confirming all sync targets have consumed them" becomes MUST, with the "only" ordering limit and "all sync targets" kept.

moved.sentence: After large purges, run `PRAGMA incremental_vacuum` to reclaim the freed pages.

judged.note: The condition (after large purges), the action (`PRAGMA incremental_vacuum`) and the reason (reclaim the freed pages) are all kept, at SHOULD.
